name: git-sqlite-vfs
description: A Git-Versioned SQLite Database via a Custom Virtual File System (VFS)

scripts.pretest: npm run build && rm -rf .db test.db .test-db .compaction-db .git .gitattributes .gitignore && git init --initial-branch=master
